first_impression: A landing page presents ApplyFlow AI as a job-application agent, with resume/job-search messaging and prominent Start your job search and account controls.
after_state: The app opened a Create your account form requiring email and password. No job-search workflow was visible without creating an account.
notes: The landing claim is clear, but the central workflow is gated behind account creation.

first_impression: A synthetic AppraiseAI workspace shows a fictional case, field evidence, an empty appraisal draft, activity ledger, comparable sales, and review-readiness controls.
action_attempted: Clicked the first Add as draft item button in Field evidence.
after_state: The page remained visually unchanged: the draft still said No objects structured yet and Mark ready for review remained disabled.
notes: The evidence-led appraisal purpose is clear, but the attempted evidence-to-draft action produced no observable state change.

first_impression: A minimal Acme CRM screen lists three clients with currencies and rates, shows the selected client's name and Notes area, and offers a Connectome button.
action_attempted: Selected Halden & Voss Architects from the client list.
after_state: The main heading changed from River North Studio to Halden & Voss Architects while the client list and Notes area remained available.
notes: Client switching works as a basic CRM interaction; the broader cross-app interoperability claim was not exercised.

first_impression: Archbro presents a project-building entry screen asking What are we building together?, with a project description control and sign-in options.
action_attempted: Clicked Describe the project you want to build.
after_state: A Welcome back login modal appeared with email/password, Google, GitHub, account creation, and Back controls.
notes: The project-building purpose is identifiable, but starting requires authentication.

first_impression: ArchForge opens to a create-system screen with a required system-name field, template browsing, and WebMCP Agent Ready indicator.
action_attempted: Entered Test Platform as the system name and clicked Create System.
after_state: A workspace opened for Test Platform with architecture canvas tools such as Client/Web, API Gateway, Service/Compute, Database, Cache, and Queue/Stream.
notes: The local architecture workspace was directly usable without login for this flow.
